status: UTC RFC3339 formatting and JSON string serialization component; parsing, Local, production integration and whole-product qualification remain separate gates.

compiler.bootstrap: Explicit Python B0, followed by native HIA B1, B2, B3 and component compilation.

entry.signature: u64 f0(const u8* source, u64 source_len, u8* output, u64 output_capacity, u8* workspace, u64 workspace_len)
entry.status_encoding: Core u32 zero extended to u64 by the fixed native borrowed-buffer wrapper.

caller_preconditions: Advertised source and output ranges are live for the synchronous call, readable for source and writable for output.
Source and output ranges do not overlap, including exact aliasing. Source is not concurrently modified.
No alignment is required. Lengths are actual allocated capacities; invalid pointers or invented capacities are outside the contract.
Zero-length workspace is never read or written. Native retains no pointers and has no mutable global state.

source.byte_order: eight little-endian u64 words; signed seconds use two's-complement bits

fields.name: length
fields.value: ASCII byte count when valid; otherwise 0

fields.name: text
fields.value: Exact original formatted bytes followed by zeros, or all zeros when invalid

output.tail: All bytes after offset 96 remain unchanged. Frame and capacity errors leave the entire output unchanged.

semantics.leap_nanoseconds: 1000000000 <= nanoseconds < 2000000000 only when Euclidean seconds modulo 60 equals 59
semantics.leap_second_rules: Match the original constructor, including leap fractions on the last second of any minute. Do not apply an external leap-second table or normalize the fraction.
semantics.calendar: Proleptic Gregorian calendar, including year zero and negative years, with floor division across negative days and 400-year eras.
semantics.invalid_values: Return a zeroed 96-byte result with version 1 and valid 0, without trapping or formatting an invalid date.
semantics.year: Years 0 through 9999 use exactly four digits. Other years use an explicit sign and at least four magnitude digits.
semantics.fractional_digits: Secs omits fractions; Millis/Micros/Nanos truncate to 3/6/9 digits. AutoSi chooses no fraction for zero, then 3 or 6 exact decimal places, otherwise 9.
semantics.leap_formatting: A valid leap fraction renders second 60 and formats nanos minus 1000000000; it does not normalize into the following minute.
semantics.json: Operation 1 always uses AutoSi and Z, surrounded by JSON double quotes. Its precision and use_z input fields must both be zero because they are reserved in this mode.
semantics.timezones: This component accepts UTC timestamps only. FixedOffset rendering and Local timezone rules are not claimed.

status_precedence.condition: output capacity is less than 96, before source or workspace validation
source length is not 64, workspace is nonempty, version is not 1, operation is not 0 or 1, metadata is outside its specified mode, or a reserved word is nonzero
valid frame; exactly 96 output bytes are written for a valid or invalid timestamp

differential_corpus.controls: Two fills and exact/excess capacities on every case; all shorter capacities, invalid frame lengths and metadata, reserved JSON fields, and nonempty workspace. Verify all input, output, tail and guard bytes.
